title: Privacy & data (M13)
brief: Privacy & data screen of goop (/privacy, from Settings). goop is local-only: encrypted SQLite (SQLite3MultipleCiphers, key sealed by TPM2 on Linux, DPAPI on Windows), no telemetry, secrets removed before any model sees text (DLP), integrity check on the database at start. Full screen, no backdrop, with a title breadcrumb (Settings › Privacy & data · goop.db on this machine · esc back to settings; no other key hints in the title, headers or rows) and a calm trust line (green ● all local · encrypted · no telemetry · 0 personal data sent); when the integrity check fails the M8 banner replaces it (⚠ goop.db changed outside goop · opened read-only · searches paused, chat and export still work · ↵ review). Two panes: on the left What goop keeps, palette-style rows (ctrl+p, M11): a 2-cell icon tile in the palette color (Offers --success, Sessions and Logs --text-muted, Rules and Profile and CV --accent, Search index --secondary, Models --primary; never lavender), then two lines: the name with its size on the right and a muted count · age, grouped as Your data · each can be cleared (Offers 18 MB · 412 · kept 90 days; Sessions 2.1 MB · 7 · until you clear, selected; Rules 4 KB · 7; Profile and CV 310 KB · cv-2026.pdf · read Oct 28; Search index 9 MB · from offers · rebuilt daily; Logs dimmed tile · empty · kept 14 days) and Not personal data (Models 31 GB · 5 roles → /models, not clearable here). The pane foot is pinned to the bottom: under a --border-subtle line, a Delete all data row with an --error trash tile and the label in --error that opens the M11 dialog on ↵, then Space used, an M8-style segmented bar with one segment per personal store sized by bytes in its tile color (2px gaps) and the legend your data 29.4 MB · models 31 GB not counted. On the right the selected store with M7 tabs Details · Protection · Retention ([ ] switch): Details shows what Sessions holds, where it is stored, how long it is kept, oldest Oct 3, last today 10:42 and largest session 412 KB, then What's inside, a read-only preview of exactly what clear removes (M9 evidence style): the 7 sessions as one-line rows with muted day and time, title, muted message count and size (adding up to 2.1 MB), the current one tagged ● current in --text-muted, no selection edge; every store shows its own preview (offers by company, rules by name); Protection shows encryption, key, recovery key (not created yet · create), encrypted files, integrity checked at start · 09:00, network (3 allowed hosts) and secrets removed; Retention holds M6 form rows (offers 90 days, logs 14 days). One status line with the privacy mode and only the focused pane's keys (↑↓ move · x clear · e export · [ ] tabs · esc back; ↵ edit · esc back on Retention), ○ next search 09:00 │ ? help on the right. Below the screen: the integrity-failed frame excerpt, the clear-sessions confirm as a small M11 box (type clear to confirm), the Protection tab and the export toast (✓ Exported to … on the left, ctrl+z undo · 4s on the right).

artboards.title: Full screen
artboards.tradeoff: Palette-style store rows (colored icon tile, name and size, muted count · age) with a pink Delete all data row and an M8-style Space used bar pinned to the bottom, plus one tabbed details pane (Details · Protection · Retention) and keys only in the status line; every store, its size and state are visible at once, stores are found by color and the bar shows where the bytes are, but the two-line rows fill the 900px frame with no spare rows (shorter terminals scroll), the bar repeats the row sizes and same-color neighbors need the rows to tell apart, the protection facts sit behind a tab, every destructive action takes a full type-to-confirm dialog, and the screen hides the chat
